problem_restatement.question: Does V57 BTC inactivity indicate that its specialist entry gates are suppressing cost-clearing opportunities?
problem_restatement.inputs: Exact current-run provider evaluations and report-only causal order-book opportunity paths.
problem_restatement.output: A route-specific retain-or-investigate disposition without changing live authority, configuration, sizing, leverage, or risk.
problem_restatement.success_criterion: Identify an independently resolved one-blocker sample that clears estimated friction consistently enough to justify a separately preregistered relaxation test.
problem_restatement.stakeholder: Human operator retains final authority for every live change.

checkpoint_projection.mutability_warning: The latest checkpoint path is mutable; this record binds the exact bytes observed at the stated generation time.

projection_contract.path_start: first full minute after candidate availability
projection_contract.interpretation: Order-book paths are causal estimated opportunity outcomes, not hypothetical fills or realized PnL.

known: All three BTC routes were executable members of the exact V57 profile during the observed window.
No sampled BTC provider evaluation was eligible.
The HULK routes were blocked by multiple simultaneous conditions rather than a single near-threshold condition.
The sweep route produced three independent resolved opportunity paths for its persistent missing-sweep blocker.
assumptions: The checkpoint projection faithfully implements the declared causal path and friction contracts for the bound ledger prefixes.
Three sweep near-miss episodes are adequate to reject an immediate relaxation proposal, but not to estimate long-run route expectancy.
Current-run absence of an expansion trigger does not establish that future valid HULK triggers will be profitable.

hulk_expansion_short_robust_v3|BTC.disposition: Retain unchanged. The sample does not isolate a gate whose relaxation can be tested causally.

hulk_expansion_short_tuned_v2|BTC.disposition: Retain unchanged. Lowering one threshold would not turn these evaluations into contract-valid short expansion entries.

liquidity_sweep_long_1h_stop60_target60_.disposition: Reject relaxing the primary sweep requirement from this evidence. Every independently resolved near-miss path was adverse after estimated friction at every measured horizon.

supported: V57 BTC inactivity during this window is consistent with contract-valid filtering rather than a missing provider evaluation or routing failure.
The current market state was not a valid short expansion setup for either HULK route.
Removing the sweep-below-prior-low requirement would have admitted three observed paths that failed to clear estimated friction.
not_supported: The BTC strategies have positive long-run expectancy.
The current thresholds are globally optimal.
A route should be removed solely because it did not trade in this approximately nine-hour window.
Estimated opportunity paths are equivalent to executable fills or realized PnL.
reasoning_chain: Check provider coverage and eligibility for each exact V57 BTC identity.
Separate multi-blocker non-setups from isolated one-blocker near misses.
Require independently resolved causal paths for any isolated blocker.
Compare close and MFE outcomes with the declared estimated-friction hurdle across multiple horizons.
Retain filters when the only isolated relaxation sample is uniformly adverse and avoid inferring unobserved route profitability.

risks_and_failure_modes: The observed window is short and contains no eligible BTC lifecycle, so it cannot validate entry, stop, target, funding, slippage, or exit performance.
The three sweep near-miss episodes are a small sample and may not represent other volatility or liquidity regimes.
Checkpoint opportunity metrics are backend-authored projections; a generator defect could invalidate them despite exact source hashes.
Estimated friction and BBO paths may understate adverse live latency, queueing, partial fills, or stop gaps.
Repeated evaluations are not independent market opportunities; only the checkpoint's independent resolved paths are used for the sweep conclusion.

recommended.action: Keep all three V57 BTC route contracts unchanged and continue prospective collection.
recommended.upside: Avoids admitting current-run paths that were uniformly adverse after estimated friction.
recommended.downside: Trading remains sparse, and a genuinely profitable regime may take time to appear.

relax_one_gate_now.downside: The only isolated sample would have added three non-cost-clearing paths; HULK does not supply an isolated gate sample.

remove_routes_now.downside: No eligible lifecycle exists in this window, so removal would be based on cadence rather than measured route economics.

investigation_specification.1_hypothesis: BTC inactivity may reflect over-restrictive entry gates.
investigation_specification.2_why_now: V57 has generated no BTC eligible entries, creating concern that live capital has no opportunity to work.
investigation_specification.3_evidence_reviewed: Exact V57 run identity, raw cohort and BTC prefixes, readiness blockers, and causal order-book opportunity projections.
investigation_specification.4_current_edge_estimate: Unidentified; this audit evaluates filtering correctness, not strategy expectancy.
investigation_specification.5_frozen_contracts: Robust-v3 short, tuned-v2 short, and sweep-long identities remain unchanged.
investigation_specification.6_alternatives_considered: Retain, relax a gate, or remove dormant routes.
investigation_specification.8_expected_upside: Prevent frequency-driven relaxation that the observed near-miss paths contradict.
investigation_specification.9_downside_risks: Sparse sample, regime dependence, projection-model error, and unknown eligible-trade economics.
investigation_specification.10_technical_validation: Exact hashes and raw evaluation/blocker reconciliation plus resolved path counts.
investigation_specification.11_economic_validation_needed: Compatible eligible lifecycles with exact fees, funding, slippage, stop and exit attribution.
investigation_specification.12_success_evidence: Independent eligible lifecycles or a preregistered one-blocker sample positive after costs and largest-winner removal.
investigation_specification.13_rollback_or_abort: No change was made; invalidate this record if identity, prefix hashes, or causal projection contract fail reconciliation.
investigation_specification.14_confidence: High on observed blocker counts and path arithmetic; medium on withholding correctness; low on future profitability.

confidence.basis: Exact run-bound ledger prefixes, raw provider evaluations, and three independently resolved one-blocker opportunity paths with no censoring or missing data.
confidence.limitations: No eligible BTC trade occurred, the sample is short, and path results are estimated opportunity outcomes rather than fills.

falsifiers_and_update_triggers: Either bound ledger prefix fails SHA-256 reconciliation.
The checkpoint generator's causal path or friction contract is shown to be defective.
An independent preregistered one-blocker sample becomes positive after exact costs and remains positive after largest-winner removal.
A compatible eligible BTC lifecycle reveals a route, stop, target, funding, slippage, or exit defect.
The active profile identity changes, requiring a new run-bound audit.

highest_value_next_investigation.action: Continue exact both-side live lifecycle collection under the unchanged V57 identity.
highest_value_next_investigation.why: It remains the highest-information unresolved incumbent question; BTC has no evidence-backed relaxation to test from this window.
highest_value_next_investigation.parallel_non_mutating_monitor: Capture the first exact eligible BTC lifecycle and reconcile its entry, stop, target, funding, slippage, and exit behavior.
